#firstaid #kitchen

Grabbed the cast iron handle straight out of a 230°C oven on 2025-01-12 (cornbread, my own fault, the silicone sleeve was in the dishwasher). What I did, and what I'd tell anyone: cool running tap water for a full 20 minutes, not ice, not butter, not toothpaste. Took off my ring right away before the finger swelled. Blister about the size of a toonie on the palm, so superficial partial thickness. Left the blister intact, covered loosely with Polysporin and a non-stick Telfa pad, changed daily. Fully healed in 11 days, slight pink patch until March. Go to urgent care if it's bigger than your palm, on the face, hands across a joint, or circumferential, which is what we tell people on the ward too. Same rule for capsaicin burns from chopping habaneros: wash with dish soap and cool water, oil first if it's really bad (learned that the hard way making [[Hot sauce mash]]). Now there's a rule about the handle mitt in [[Cast iron care]].
